attr.title: Screendump
attr.desc:
See your Elektron instrument's screen on the handheld, over MIDI, using the instrument's own screenshot command. Nothing on the machine is modified. Pairing loop cycles Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt and streams the first machine that answers, at the instrument's own refresh rate.

Runs inside the vaixterm terminal emulator with a full gptokeyb gamepad control layer: A=save frame, B=quit stream back to pairing, X=render mode (braille/blocks/ascii), Y=invert, L1=help, R1=flip, L2/R2=pause. Requires an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt connected by USB-MIDI. Fully exit with the EmulationStation hotkey.
attr.inst: Requires a USB-MIDI connection to an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt (GLOBAL > USB CFG > USB MIDI on the machine). python-rtmidi is bundled for aarch64 by the build script. Swap machines at any time -- the port re-pairs automatically when the stream ends.
